comment: The component appears to cover record storage, exchange, patient access, aggregation, consent enforcement, and possibly analytics. Combining all these responsibilities can create an overly broad national platform.

public.text: The component appears to cover record storage, exchange, patient access, aggregation, consent enforcement, and possibly analytics. Combining all these responsibilities can create an overly broad national platform.
public.suggestedRevision: Separate the logical services of record contribution, discovery, retrieval, longitudinal assembly, patient access, consent or policy enforcement, and secondary-use export. Clarify which are core LHR responsibilities and which are provided by other components.
